Privacy Policy

Last updated: 27 October 2026

We take your privacy seriously: we collect as little as possible and never sell your data.

Who we are

The controller of the data collected on this site is Gringo's Washboard Band. For any privacy question, write to us at contato@gringoswashboard.com.br.

What data we collect

  • Newsletter: if you sign up, the email you give us, only to send you news about the band.
  • Contact: whatever you send us by email, phone or WhatsApp, only to reply to you.
  • Visit statistics: if you accept cookies, Google Analytics collects usage data (pages viewed, device type, approximate country). See the Cookie Policy.
  • Technical logs: the service that hosts the site logs visitors' IP address and browser, for security reasons.

Legal basis

We process newsletter data and statistics based on your consent, which you can withdraw at any time; contact messages, to answer your request; and technical logs, in our legitimate interest of keeping the site secure.

Third-party services

To work, the site uses a few external services, which receive your IP address when the page loads them:

  • Google Fonts (typefaces) and cdnjs / Cloudflare (icons);
  • YouTube (privacy-enhanced mode, only when you click a video) and SoundCloud (music player);
  • Google Analytics, only if you accept cookies.

Links to Facebook, Instagram, YouTube and WhatsApp take you to those services, which have their own privacy policies. Some of these providers may process data outside the European Union, under the safeguards provided for in the GDPR.

How long we keep it

Newsletter data is kept until you unsubscribe; contact messages, as long as needed to reply to you; Google Analytics statistics, for at most 14 months.

Your rights

Under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you can ask us for access to, rectification, erasure, restriction or portability of your data, object to its processing and withdraw your consent, by writing to contato@gringoswashboard.com.br. You can also lodge a complaint with the Portuguese data protection authority, the Comissão Nacional de Proteção de Dados (CNPD).

Changes

If we change this policy, we will publish the new version here, with the date it was updated.
